C7FJ.astuce: Enter: roll · Esc: cancel · ← →: dice · 1-4: difficulty

aide.d0: Unknown difficulty: the Keeper sets it after the roll.
aide.d1: Regular: roll equal to or under the value.
aide.d2: Hard: roll equal to or under half the value.
aide.d3: Extreme: roll equal to or under a fifth of the value.
aide.des: Bonus die: roll an extra tens die and keep the best. Penalty die: keep the worst. They cancel one for one (2 at most).
aide.chances: Probability of success with this difficulty and these dice (01 always succeeds, 100 always fails).
aide.inconnue: * Unknown difficulty: chance shown for a regular difficulty.

reglage.aide: Replaces the layout of the CoC7 roll window (difficulty tiles, dice steps, chance of success). Untick to get the original back.
